length.label: Length (cm)

caughtAt.error: Enter an existing date and time.

location.added: The location will be saved with the catch.
location.failed: Could not get the location — you can save the catch without it.

check.kept: The fish counts towards the daily limit.

result.acceptedText: The catch complies with the water's rules.
result.rejectedText: The entry is in the register as rejected. You can correct or delete it until {{until}}.
result.rejectedClosed: The entry is in the register as rejected. The time to change it has passed.
result.savedText: The catch will be sent to the register when the network is back.
result.sending: Sending the catch to the register…

result.notSent: Could not send the catch right now — it is waiting on the device. We will try again when you open the app or the network is back.

register.empty: No catches have been recorded this season yet.
register.deleteConfirm: Delete this catch from the register?
register.deleted: The catch has been deleted from the register.
register.offline: Without a network only catches saved on this device are shown. You will see the full register once you are connected.
